authority.planning_authority: closes exact-zero and exact-2of4 sparsity as an order-of-magnitude Prefill architecture for this pinned checkpoint

method.source_format: Safetensors U8 tensors with shape [N,K/2] and two E2M1 codes per byte
method.zero_sign_handling: both positive-zero and negative-zero encodings are counted
method.k4_definition: the four consecutive stored-K E2M1 codes in two adjacent packed bytes
method.structured_test: count a K4 group when at least two of its four codes satisfy the exact-zero predicate

decision.reason: Only 7.945540% of all pinned MLP E2M1 values are exact signed-or-unsigned zero codes, and only 3.540535% of consecutive K4 groups contain at least two such codes. The distribution is consistently low across every one of the 192 tensors. It cannot remove the order-of-magnitude dense work required by the target and does not justify a sparse-kernel architecture.
decision.additional_numerical_boundary: Even an exact zero code cannot be silently skipped under the complete finite-precision contract without preserving zero-times-NaN and signed-zero behavior. This audit measures structure; it does not grant a sparse production equivalence.
decision.next_step: Do not build or benchmark an exact-sparsity successor for this checkpoint. Continue with reference-parity dense dataflow and whole-core mathematical/communication redesign.
